caption:
Most service businesses lose leads to slow response times, not bad marketing.

The Lead Response Audit shows you exactly where your shop stands.

Four inputs: monthly leads, average job value, how fast you respond, and how you respond.

It hands back a response score graded against industry benchmarks, an estimate of leads going cold every month, and the revenue sitting at risk because of it.

Four minutes to run. Free. No card, no signup.
